summary: Add or review non-sequence CMSIS-Pack Debug Description content in an existing Device Family Pack PDSC, applying only user-confirmed definitions and reporting their XML placement, applicability, evidence, unresolved items, and validation results.
triggers: after `$debug-access-knowledge` has established the required access facts
verification: Run `$validate-pdsc-sequence-xml` after applying the confirmed change.
For a non-sequence-only change, inspect its file-wide block-format matches and record that the change introduced no C-like block content; resolve every relevant validation failure.
stop_conditions: Require a current record covering the selected connection and non-sequence definitions; return to `$debug-access-knowledge` when it is absent, blocked, stale, contradictory, or insufficient.
Present the debug-access knowledge record and proposed XML, then apply only user-confirmed changes.
Return missing or contradictory hardware facts to `$debug-access-knowledge`.
Stop when no existing device description exists, the knowledge record is inadequate, user confirmation is absent, or XML/PDSC validation fails.

rules.delta: topology facts, addresses, protocols, patches, values, or applicability. Return missing or contradictory hardware facts to `$debug-access-knowledge`.
unless authoritative inputs require it. Identify each required dependency in the output.
